name: screenhistory
description: Screen history for mobile apps: see every past iteration of every screen, diff any two builds, and find the build where something first changed — powered by Revyl Atlas.

plugins.name: screenhistory
plugins.description: Skill that installs atlas-review, points it at a Revyl app, and produces the self-contained visual-review report: build-over-build diffs, blame, approvals, and policy alerts for CI.
